# Gabriel Arias · Shopify performance & technical SEO

> One operator, Shopify only. Two 30-day sprints, sold separately, each with a
> written guarantee. A free audit on either arrives within 48 hours, in
> writing, with no call attached.

Every figure on this site is a measurement with a source and a date, or it is
not published. The site measures itself with the same tools it sells:
the raw output is in /medicion/.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/): both tracks side by side, what the free audit contains, the process and the FAQ.
- [Speed sprint](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/speed.html): Shopify page speed in 30 days. Guarantee: PageSpeed 85+ or full refund. $2,750.
- [Technical SEO sprint](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/seo.html): the 22 technical checks that decide whether Google can crawl, index and read a Shopify store. Guarantee: every failed check green, or full refund. Never a promise about positions or traffic. $2,400.
- Spanish versions: [/es/](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/es/), [/es/speed.html](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/es/speed.html), [/es/seo.html](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/es/seo.html).

## Terms

- The two sprints are never bundled and never discounted together. Run back to back they take 50 days: three weeks of speed, then four of SEO.
- Retainer after a sprint: $1,500 per month.
- Prices in USD.

## Measurements of this site

- [Summary](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/medicion/resumen.json): PageSpeed Insights, median of three runs per strategy, and the SEO check count.
- [SEO checks](https://gaboauditmyweb.dev/medicion/seo.json): all 22 checks, each with its state, value and source.
